scoring_rules_extra.rule: Find underlyings from GET /api/automation/reddit (ingest first). Rank mentions that are also in allowed_symbols. Do not default to a fixed NVDA/SPY shopping list; SPY/QQQ are allowed only if Reddit actually mentioned them or you already hold a lot.
New entries need a named Reddit thread/mention plus tape or a fillable 0DTE chain. One viral post alone is not enough. If the name has no 0DTE listing, skip — do not buy a weekly.

required_inputs_extra.name: reddit_research
required_inputs_extra.description: Public finance-subreddit posts are the primary name source.
